title.why: The English title omits the amendments to EU regulations and directives that the long title lists and names only three laws; an abbreviated rendering, not wrong.

date_last_updated.why: Clearing 2026-07-10 is correct: it is the dossier's update date, not a new version of the bill.

summary_claims.claim: Sandbox deadline of 2 August 2026 and approval of a real-world test plan if the authority does not answer within 30 days. Literal translation: 'where the market surveillance authority has not given an answer within 30 days, the real-world tests and the real-world test plan are deemed approved.'
summary_claims.locator: bill articles on sandbox and testing

summary_claims.claim: Council of State renders formal objections (opposition formelle) on the CSSF's remit under Article 74(6) of the AI Act; Government Commissioner renamed by the law of 19 December 2025
